sentences.en: I don't think Friday is feasible anymore.
I was wondering if we could push back the release to next Wednesday.
That sounds like a reasonable trade-off.
I wanted to flag something about the project timeline.
I was wondering if we could push back the deadline by two days.
We could reduce the scope and deliver the most important part first.
Thanks for being flexible. I'll keep you updated.
I was wondering if you could review my slides before the meeting.
sentences.zh: 不知道你能不能在開會前幫我看一下簡報。

sentences.en: Would it be possible to move our call to 3 p.m.?
sentences.zh: 我們的通話可以改到下午三點嗎？

sentences.en: Would you mind sending me the latest version?
sentences.zh: 可以麻煩你把最新版本寄給我嗎？

sentences.en: I'd like to flag an issue first: this timeline might not be feasible.
sentences.zh: 我想先提出一個問題：這個時程可能不太可行。

sentences.en: If we reduce the scope, we can still launch on Friday.
sentences.zh: 如果我們縮小範圍，週五還是可以上線。

sentences.en: I was wondering if we could push back the meeting to next Monday.
sentences.zh: 不知道我們能不能把會議延到下週一？

sentences.en: We could, but something has to give.
That way nothing that's already been promised slips.
I'd rather not commit to a date until we've scoped it properly.
We've finished the search page, and we reached the testing milestone on Wednesday.
Their legal team hasn't signed off on the contract yet.
I emailed them on Monday and called yesterday.
Overall, the project is on track for the end of the month.
We've finished the search page, and testing started on Wednesday.
Our main blocker is that legal hasn't signed off on the contract yet.
I'll follow up with them on Thursday and keep you posted.
We've completed three of the five milestones so far.
sentences.zh: 到目前為止我們完成了五個里程碑中的三個。

sentences.en: We completed the second milestone last Thursday.
sentences.zh: 我們上週四完成了第二個里程碑。

sentences.en: Has the client signed off on the design yet?
Overall, the project is still on track.
sentences.zh: 整體來說，這個專案仍按計畫進行。

sentences.en: We've finished the payment flow.
sentences.zh: 我們已經完成了付款流程。

sentences.en: We rolled out the new version last Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 我們上週二推出了新版本。

sentences.en: Legal hasn't signed off on the contract yet, and that's our biggest blocker right now.
sentences.zh: 法務還沒核准合約，這是我們目前最大的卡關點。

sentences.en: The refund pages will carry over to next week, and I'll follow up with the vendor tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 退款頁面會順延到下週，我明天會再跟供應商追蹤。

sentences.en: I'd honestly rather hear about the bumps.
We've only got a four-hour window on launch night.
Priya's been carrying this on her own.

grammar.q: I was wondering ___ you could help me with the budget report.
grammar.explain_zh: I was wondering 後面用 if 或 whether 帶出一個子句。
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: Would you mind ___ the door? It's a bit noisy outside.
grammar.explain_zh: Would you mind 後面接 V-ing：Would you mind closing…?
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: Which request sounds the most polite in an email to a senior manager?
options: I was wondering if we could move the deadline to Friday.
You need to move the deadline.
grammar.explain_zh: I was wondering if we could… 用過去進行式＋could，語氣最委婉。
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: Would it be possible ___ (extend) the deadline by two days?
grammar.explain_zh: Would it be possible + to + 原形動詞。
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: A colleague asks, "Would you mind if I joined the meeting?" You are happy for them to join. What do you say?
grammar.explain_zh: mind 是「介意」。回答 Not at all（一點也不介意）才是「可以」。
grammar.point: Polite requests: I was wondering if… / Would it be possible to…
grammar.point_zh: 委婉請求：I was wondering if… ／ Would it be possible to…

grammar.q: We ___ the new dashboard to all users last Monday.
grammar.explain_zh: 有明確過去時間 last Monday，要用過去簡單式 rolled out。
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: So far this week, we ___ (fix) twelve bugs.
grammar.explain_zh: So far this week（到目前為止）表示期間還沒結束，用現在完成式 have fixed。
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

options: I have sent the report yesterday.
I have send the report yesterday.
I was sent the report yesterday by me.
grammar.explain_zh: yesterday 是明確過去時間，不能和現在完成式連用，所以是 I sent the report yesterday。
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: Legal still ___ (not / sign) off on the contract, so we can't start.
grammar.explain_zh: still … not 表示到現在還沒發生，主詞 Legal 視為單數，用 hasn't signed。
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式

grammar.q: A: "When did you finish the migration?" B: "We ___ it on Wednesday night."
grammar.explain_zh: 問句用 When did…，問的是過去的時間點，回答也用過去式 finished。
grammar.point_zh: 現在完成式 vs 過去簡單式
